district_name: Waits River Valley Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(F) inventory: Waits River Valley Union School District (Unified School District No. 36), a union school district in the Orange East Supervisory Union (member towns: Corinth, Topsham). Operates PK-8.

board.org_name: Waits River Valley Union School Board

sources.note: OESU Waits River Valley board page (official, fetched 2026-10-22) and the district's 2025-2026 Annual Report officers list -- the two newest rosters agree: Aebi (Corinth) 2026-2029, Tkac (Corinth) 2025-2028, Emerson (Topsham, Chair) 2025-2028, Rogers (Topsham) 2026-2029, Thurston (Topsham) 2025-2027. Model (town-only electorates): Topsham's March 5, 2024 town meeting minutes (Art. 8) elect a Waits River Valley director by floor nomination for a 3-year term; the district's May annual meeting elects officers only (2025/2026 warnings, Art. 1). Thurston: appointed by the Topsham Selectboard March 11, 2024 for one year after Appleton's resignation; her current published term (2025-2027, both rosters) brackets an election at Topsham's March 2025 town meeting (minutes not fetched) -- minted ELECTED (the appointment-to-election pattern). HELD: Alexis Ruggles (Corinth) -- she replaced Goyette-Stevens between the board's Jan. 8 and Feb. 12, 2026 meetings with no appointment or election in the board minutes (by district practice the Corinth Selectboard would appoint; its Jan.-Feb. 2026 minutes are the resolving document), and her end conflicts (2027 OESU page vs. 2029 Annual Report). NOT minted: Goyette-Stevens (departed, end undocumented), Nancy Ertle (retired 2025), Kara Appleton (resigned March 2024), Heather Lawler (the OESU Superintendent -- not a director). The 3+3 allocation rests on the uniform rosters; the articles were not fetched. UPDATE 2026-10-28: Corinth Town Clerk Martha Brough supplied the Corinth Selectboard minutes for January and February 2026; BOTH sets were read firsthand and NEITHER records any school-board appointment, resignation or vacancy action (Jan. 7, 2026 approved minutes, corinthvt.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/selectboard-min-2026-01-07-approved.pdf; Feb. 3, 2026 approved minutes, corinthvt.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/selectboard-min-2026-02-03-approved.pdf -- no mention of Ruggles or of a school director seat). Ruggles therefore remains HELD. The resolving documents are now: the Corinth Selectboard minutes of Jan. 12 or Feb. 16/18, 2026, or Corinth's March 2026 town-meeting record. Name-form note: district publications (the 2025-2026 Parent & Scholar Handbook roster; the 2025 Annual Meeting minutes) style the departed Corinth director 'Jeremiah Goyette' (term-year 2026), not the hyphenated 'Goyette-Stevens' carried in this spec -- he remains unminted (departed, end undocumented), so no record changes, but the hyphenated form should not be relied on.
